scope: Batch 3 published farm activity report and rework metric source contract

report.source_filter: farm_activity.location_id, status = published, inclusive activity_date period
report.snapshot_contract: services/export/reports/context.py::store_snapshot stores a SHA-256 hashed status=draft, frozen=false snapshot

metric.cohort: location lifecycle entities published in the inclusive date period, including farm_activity
metric.formula: published entities with a rejected transition / published entities * 100
metric.provenance: published source IDs and reworked subset are returned, each capped at 100 with truncation flags
metric.verification: services/metrics/engine.py inserts metric_value.verified=false; separate human verification remains required

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --cache-dir /private/tmp/kokonut-kernel-uv-cache --with 'pytest>=9.1.1,<10.0' --with 'psycopg2-binary>=2.9.9' pytest tests/test_farm_activity_metrics.py tests/test_farm_activity_summary_report.py tests/test_report_governance.py tests/test_metrics.py::test_metric_computation_always_creates_draft_value -q
verification.ruff: All checks passed for the changed Python files
verification.method: Isolated fake database cursors and synthetic UUIDs; no live candidate or production records used

disposable_postgresql.runtime: PostGIS 16 disposable container on the private Docker network
disposable_postgresql.schema_scope: minimal synthetic tables matching the report and metric query contracts; no repository migration chain applied
disposable_postgresql.cleanup: temporary database container removed; candidate app/database and volumes unchanged

limitations: The full-schema replay applied schema migrations only; seed data was excluded and the metric definition was an ephemeral synthetic fixture
PostgreSQL duplicate-promotion parity remains open; the real PostgreSQL failure injection covered lifecycle transition event rollback
The candidate database and app were not migrated, rebuilt, or written
Configured-provider acceptance and MAN-CAP-001 remain open

full_schema_parity.runtime: PostGIS 16 disposable Compose project; repository candidate remained unchanged
full_schema_parity.schema_scope: All 375 ordered PostgreSQL schema migrations applied by services.migration.cli with --schemas-only; no seed migrations
full_schema_parity.cleanup: Disposable database volume and Compose network removed; candidate app, database, and volumes unchanged

database_trigger_failure.method: Synthetic PostgreSQL BEFORE INSERT trigger rejected the submitted workflow event while the real transition service updated the canonical row
assertions: farm_activity remained draft after the transition raised
database_trigger_failure.scope: Disposable full-schema PostGIS 16 database only; trigger and rows were synthetic and removed with the scratch project

additional_cases: wrong-location detail query binds the requested location and returns no row
wrong-location draft promotion performs no canonical write
injected workflow-event insert failure after the draft insert triggers rollback and closes the connection
focused_batch_3_acceptance.limitation: Its injected unit-double failure is supplemented by the real PostgreSQL transition failure check recorded under full_schema_parity; PostgreSQL duplicate-promotion parity remains open.
focused_batch_3_acceptance.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --cache-dir /private/tmp/kokonut-kernel-uv-cache --with 'pytest>=9.1.1,<10.0' --with 'psycopg2-binary>=2.9.9' pytest tests/test_migration.py tests/test_workflow_specs.py tests/test_farm_activity_workflow.py tests/test_farm_activity_lifecycle.py tests/test_operator_auth.py tests/test_farm_activity_metrics.py tests/test_farm_activity_summary_report.py tests/test_report_governance.py tests/test_metrics.py::test_metric_computation_always_creates_draft_value -q
